products.name: Remote Help — Commercial
products.short_description: Give your help desk secure, audited, RBAC-governed remote assistance. Stand it up yourself with self-guided, tested steps for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Secure, audited remote assistance — not risky ad-hoc tools

Ad-hoc remote-support tools are a security liability: unverified helpers, no role controls, no audit trail, and third-party software you do not fully trust. Remote Help is Microsoft's cloud remote-assistance solution built into the Intune ecosystem — helpers are authenticated with Microsoft Entra, gated by role-based access control, shown the device's compliance state, and every session is audited.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Remote Help. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Remote Help works and its security model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (including licensing) with verify/implement steps.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered Intune steps: enable, deploy the app, assign RBAC, and run a session.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — app discovery, validation, tenant settings check, remediation, and a session/usage report.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A secure, audited, role-controlled help desk — Entra-authenticated helpers, compliance-aware sessions, and a full audit trail — that replaces risky ad-hoc tools with a service you fully govern.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • RHELP-Discovery.ps1 — Remote Help readiness check on the device
    • RHELP-Remediation.ps1 — force an app/policy sync to (re)install the Remote Help app
    • RHELP-SessionReport.ps1 — report Remote Help session/usage activity for auditing (Graph)
    • RHELP-SettingsCheck.ps1 — confirm Remote Help is enabled tenant-wide with chosen options (Graph)
    • RHELP-Validation.ps1 — confirm the Remote Help app is installed and ready on this device

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
